changelog_0_3_0: 2026-09-16 methodology audit on live SEC EDGAR data. Engine rules, no threshold changes: (1) insufficient valuation data abstains instead of scoring 0 = avoid; (2) dividend_cover criterion now computed (weight was configured but inert); (3) PEGY undefined for non-positive EPS growth; (4) cyclical category from SEC SIC when the source gives no cyclicality; (5) cycle_position criterion computed from EPS history (weight was configured but inert); (6) EDGAR EPS growth is a multi-year CAGR, not one year.
description: Canonical, machine-readable Peter Lynch strategy thresholds. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. PROMPT.md cites these illustratively but MUST NOT contradict them; CI fails on drift. Thresholds are research-derived (see DipBuyer-AI-Research-Brief.md §1) and tagged by provenance: 'lynch_book' (Lynch's own numbers) vs 'impl_default' (canonical encoded screens e.g. Validea/AAII).

conventions.peg_note: PEG = PE / EPS_growth_pct_whole_number. PEGY = PE / (EPS_growth_pct + dividend_yield_pct). NEVER mix with the reciprocal (growth+yield)/PE form.

buy.note: P/E LOOKS high on depressed trough earnings — do NOT apply naive PEG gate
Use net cash / property / holdings value, NOT earnings-based PEG; net cash = price floor

value_profitability_interaction.rationale: The value premium concentrates in PROFITABLE value. 1973-2023 CRSP/Compustat double-sorts: high-BM+high-profitability 16.27/17.13/19.44% CAGR (large/mid/small) vs market 12.12/13.47/14.32; high-BM+LOW-profitability ~market (11.92/13.07/15.02). Cheap-without-profitability is the trap cell, not a bargain. Confirmation axis is cash flow (Piotroski's CFO>0), not ROE, which is meaningless under buyback-negative equity.

scoring.buy_excluded_categories_note: Lynch cyclicals are timing bets; on the S&P 500 2016-2020 the engine's cyclical buys lagged SPY by 12.5% over 12 months. Hold/sell verdicts are unaffected. provenance: backtest_experiment_E2b_2026-09-17
scoring.note: Conviction 0-100 = weighted roll-up of the per-category checklist; MUST be reconstructible from the checklist with no opaque adjustments.

not_implemented.note: Lynch rules documented here but NOT applied by the engine (moved out of the live blocks in v0.4.1 so the config only states what the code does). Implementing any of them changes decisions: backtest first (HANDOVER rules).
